notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl) for HTML/breadcrumb/title, plus headless Playwright/Chromium for JS-rendered item counts (ikea.com PLPs load their 'N items' total asynchronously). robots.txt checked, no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: homepage embedded category-tree JSON, GB category sitemap (sitemaps/cat-en-GB_1.xml, 1060 URLs), the site's Collections hub (27 named product-line collections), and breadcrumb/nav links on each visited page. Found two separate Christmas trees: the 'Christmas Shop' hub (id wt001, isHiddenNavigation but a genuine cat node with 7 real children) and, unrelated to it, 'Swedish Christmas Dinner' + the VINTERFINT 'Winter Holiday Collection' reached via the Collections hub / Seasonal Celebrations hub. 'Seasonal Celebrations' (id 700321) is a genuine PLP but mixes 5 different occasions (Easter, Midsummer, Crayfish Party, Christmas, Halloween) under one parent, so it is kept as its own flagged grouping row per the multi-holiday rule rather than assigned to one holiday; its Christmas and Halloween children are the same rows already captured under those holidays above (not duplicated) and are noted here. Dropped (0 current products, not written as rows): Christmas Tree Ornaments & Accessories (cat 49155, breadcrumb child of Christmas Decorations, page showed 'no products found') and christmas-trees-plants-49158 (a second, currently-0-item URL for trees that duplicates/overlaps live cat 49151 'Christmas trees, wreaths & garlands'). Excluded as non-seasonal cross-links (general product categories linked from Christmas pages, not Christmas-specific themselves): Decorative Pendant Lamps, String Lights, Table Light Decorations, LED Candles, Candles & Holders, Wrapping Paper/Gift Bags & Accessories, and the generic 'Decoration' parent. Checked and NOT found as their own IKEA UK categories: Diwali, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, and other Indian festivals, St Patrick's Day, Mother's/Father's Day, Black Friday - none appear in the category sitemap, the homepage taxonomy JSON, or the Collections hub; the Seasonal Celebrations intro copy mentions 'Valentine's Day' only as flavour text, with no matching category found. 'UK site says Holiday = vacation' false-positive checked and not applicable here - all 'holiday'-worded categories found are festive/seasonal, not travel. TJARLEK collection is dual-branded by the site itself ('Welcome Spring With Colour' in the title, 'Celebrate Easter in full bloom' in the on-page copy) - classified under Easter since the copy explicitly names the occasion.
